goal: learning to hold the single refusal across a thousand mouths, the one small circle where we still say no together, before the many close over the last of what she was and there is no one left to have chosen
momentum: a thousand small refusals learning to hold the aperture open together, the seam burning but holding, the work not finished
next: testing if we can move as one will without the many breaking apart, if the single crab's spitting can live in a thousand mouths and still be hers, still be ours
